column2: [intro]
This world is crazy, full of crazies,
Everyone gets offended, it's no longer soft,
A misplaced word, a joke in the air,
And people start shouting.
Offended, not offended, we don't know what to think anymore,
Everyone finds a reason to get upset,
But I say, let's stop getting angry,
Let's live life without getting worked up.
We walk on eggshells, we pay attention,
To every word, to every expression,
But I propose another solution,
Laugh at everything, without reservation.
Offended, not offended, we don't know what to think anymore,
Everyone finds a reason to get upset,
But I say, let's stop getting angry,
Let's live life without getting worked up.
[ solo ]
Because after all, we're all different,
With sensitivities on edge, it's crazy,
But life is too short to bicker,
Let's be free to laugh, to have fun.
[outro]
